title: AsyncJob
description: Asynchronous worker job for imports, exports, reports and QC evaluations (technical specification 'Import/export/report' row). Jobs are idempotent, retry with limits, and dead-letter visibly. An export job cannot outlive a revoked permission: every download URL is a proxied, expiring authorization-checked link, never an independent reusable storage URL.

requestedBy.description: Requesting principal, derived from session or scoped token.

filters.description: Normalized FilterSet snapshot the job was created under (exports/reports).

dataRevision.description: Data revision the job's snapshot was taken at.

expiresAt.description: UTC instant the job record and its output manifest expire.

downloadUrl.description: Proxied, expiring, reauthorized download route; null until the job succeeds.

rowLimit.description: Explicit row/time limit applied to large exports.

error.description: Terminal failure detail using the shared Problem shape.
